snippet.title: Speechbound - GAMEPLAY teaser 2025 #RisingTideChallenge
snippet.description:
Watch the new GAMEPLAY teaser for our award winning language-learning video game ⭐SPEECHBOUND⭐
We're currently looking for an investor, get in touch here:
info [at] moonspiregames.com

Our studio Moonspire Games already won 2 awards for Speechbound 🙏
- Game Con Canada 2024 "Most Innovative Indie Game"
- Game Con Canada 2025 "Best Studio"

If you like this project, please support us by giving us a 👍like and ✏️comment! It would be amazing if you could 💌share our video and ✅ subscribe to our channel!

🔸WISHLIST Speechbound on Steam 🕹️ 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521500/Speechbound__A_language_RPG/

🔸Join us on DISCORD:
https://discord.com/invite/Vf8b6K5kad

🔸Sign up for our upcoming #kickstarter campaign:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/speechbound/speechbound-a-language-learning-rpg

ALL OTHER social networks:
🔸 https://bento.me/speechbound

#gameplay #videogames #rpg #gaming #gamingvideos 
#gamer #languagelearning #RisingTideChallenge
